actionAuditFindings.method: Manual matches are treated as authoritative; automatic proximity matches remain candidates only. For each fixed match, actionPurpose/xActionSummary/rdxActionSummary/actionNotes describe whether the bundle is walk/die/rest, trap activation, collectible pickup, score popup, explosion/destruction, moving platform, or port-specific decoration.
actionAuditFindings.rdxLadderFrames: RDX Rick/player has PN0x5D/decimal93 as a two-frame neutral ladder_climb sequence. No separate up-ladder vs down-ladder PN was found in the current sidecar/catalog. Xrick Rick climb uses native sprites 0x0C/0x18. Treat direction as behavior/state, not as two separate RDX graphical assets unless later ROM tracing proves otherwise.
actionAuditFindings.enemyClimbFrames: Xrick artbase_37 has a type2_climb action; many other xrick enemies do not. No generic RDX enemy ladder climb set is exposed in current matches. Keep this as a missing-action candidate for later behavior pass.
actionAuditFindings.ammoExplosion: Xrick ammo/box entities 0x10 and 0x11 have idle_box and explode_box actions. The matched RDX ammo-like object has not yet been tied to a separate explosion PN; keep explosion as an action-level TODO rather than bundling it into score popup or pickup.
actionAuditFindings.movingPlatforms: RDX PN029/PN02A/PN02B are neutral multi-frame mechanism sequences and should remain with xrick entity 0x1D/0x1E moving-platform/floor-mechanism bundles, not PN033/PN034.
